title: Markus build: fail loudly on article/section files whose slug contains capital letters (currently skipped silently)
description:
Markus build discovery (src/papyrus_content/markus_renderer/build.py: _ARTICLE_SLUG and the section discovery regex) silently SKIPS any article/section file whose slug has capital letters (e.g. Paytronix.md). The page goes missing while the build succeeds.

Fix: fail the build with a clear error naming the offending file(s) and the slug rule (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Do NOT start accepting capitals (URL-shape change). Must not change Pilobol.us output (byte-identical proof per PR #85).

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/89 (branch fix/PPY-8e6068-slug-case). Pilobol.us byte-identical (89 files, empty diff); Anth.us staging lowercases all 128 slugs. Left open for merge.
